from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetFinding(BaseModel):
    """An extraction of the Total Current Assets figure (or similar) from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or entity filing the report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the asset line item in the document (e.g. 'Total Current Assets', 'Total Assets')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the assets reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document anchoring this finding")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_findings: list[AssetFinding]
